Easy Banking

Hassle-free banking throughout your daily journey

Make most of the transactions you need to through your Mobile Banking. We've made the most frustrating transactions so easy!

Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, Emirates NBD Pay. With Contactless Payments, you won't need to carry a card anymore.

Even when you don’t have your card, you can pull out some cash from an ATM with Cardless Cash Withdrawals.

Transfer money to your friends instantly, literally, with MePay.
A full customizable experience with Online Banking to make Banking much much easier.

Transfer money back home in 60 seconds for free with DirectRemit! Can you even send an email that quick?

We'll make sure that your money is safe! CHIP & PIN Security, DoubleSecure for Online, and Zero Liability for Unauthorized Payments.

Pay all your Utility Payments on your Mobile, there's no need to download so many other apps!
A network of more than 750 ATMs across the UAE, you'll find one around every corner!

For those times you ACTUALLY need to visit a branch, you get free Teller Transactions.
More than 90 Branches, sometimes even in the middle of nowhere.

International ATM Access and Merchant Acceptance. You can basically, pay wherever you're traveling!
